title: WWII Leaving on the train. Glen Foster, Harold Aiton, Frank McMullin, Howard Aiton
description: In July 1929, four cadets travelled by train to the Sussex cadet camp. From left: Corporal Glen Foster, Corporal Harold Aiton, Lieutenant Frank McMullin, and Sergeant Howard Aiton. (Photo courtesy of Harold Aiton)
